hero.title: Reinventing Home Services in Morocco
hero.subtitle: Maalem is a modern digital platform built to connect people with trusted repair and maintenance professionals — faster, safer, and smarter.
hero.description: From emergency plumbing issues to electrical repairs and air conditioning maintenance, Maalem simplifies how Moroccans find reliable help when they need it most.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.content: Our mission is to modernize and simplify access to home services across Morocco by creating a trusted ecosystem between customers and skilled professionals. We aim to reduce the stress, uncertainty, and delays often associated with finding qualified technicians by offering a fast, transparent, and technology-driven solution.

whyMaalem.title: Why Maalem Exists
whyMaalem.content: Finding a reliable technician during an urgent situation can be difficult, time-consuming, and unpredictable. Many households, property managers, and Airbnb hosts struggle with delayed interventions, lack of trust, unclear pricing, and difficulty finding available professionals quickly. At the same time, many skilled workers lack visibility and access to consistent opportunities. Maalem was created to bridge this gap.

whatWeOffer.title: What We Offer
whatWeOffer.content: Maalem is a mobile-first platform that allows users to post maintenance or repair requests, receive offers from nearby professionals, compare responses and pricing, track interventions in real time, and access trusted and verified technicians.

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.content: We envision a future where accessing reliable maintenance services is as simple as ordering transportation or food online. Our goal is to build a scalable ecosystem that empowers local professionals while improving everyday life for millions of users across Morocco.

builtForMorocco.title: Designed Around Moroccan Realities
builtForMorocco.content: Maalem is built specifically for the Moroccan market. We understand local service habits, cash-based transactions, the importance of trust and reputation, and the need for multilingual accessibility.

trustAndSafety.title: Trust Comes First
trustAndSafety.content: We believe trust is the foundation of every successful service interaction. Maalem focuses on professional verification, ratings and reviews, transparent communication, real-time coordination, and service accountability to create a safer and more reliable experience for both customers and professionals.

technology.title: Powered by Smart Technology
technology.content: Maalem combines technology and user experience to create a faster and more efficient maintenance ecosystem.

team.title: Who We Are
team.content: Maalem was created by a team of four engineering students passionate about technology, innovation, and solving real-world problems. As future engineers, we wanted to build a solution capable of modernizing access to maintenance and repair services in Morocco while creating better opportunities for both customers and professionals.
team.shortDescription: We are four engineering students united by a shared vision: using technology to solve everyday problems and create impactful digital solutions for Morocco.

closing.title: Building the Future of Home Services
closing.content: Maalem is more than a maintenance platform. It is a step toward the digital transformation of local services in Morocco — creating better opportunities for professionals and better experiences for customers. We are building a smarter, faster, and more connected future for home services.
